description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, a DbContext implementation for Entity Framework Core, managing database sets and model configurations for the Conduit application, including transaction handling.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core DbContext for managing Conduit database entities and transactions.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures entity relationships and keys, including many-to-many join tables and delete behaviors.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling and disposal.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes the current transaction.
